question: The historic Salt March was started by Mahatma Gandhi and his followers from ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sabarmati Ashram**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The historic Salt March, also known as the Dandi March, was initiated by Mahatma Gandhi from the **Sabarmati Ashram** on March 12, 1930.
 
• This march was a significant act of civil disobedience against the British salt monopoly in colonial India.
 
• Gandhi and his followers marched approximately 240 miles to the coastal village of Dandi, where they made salt from seawater, defying British laws.
 
• The march attracted worldwide attention and was a pivotal event in the Indian independence movement, showcasing the power of nonviolent protest.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sabarmati Ashram**, also known as Gandhi Ashram, was one of the residences of Mahatma Gandhi who lived there for about 12 years along with his wife, Kasturba Gandhi.
 
• The ashram served as one of the main centers of the Indian freedom struggle.
 
• It is located in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, on the banks of the River Sabarmati.
 
• The ashram is now a national monument and a museum, preserving the legacy of Mahatma Gandhi and the Indian independence movement.
